summary: With three versatile configurations, a tactile matte white finish, and advanced rimless technology, the collection delivers elevated design with everyday practicality.
title: Meet Manhattan: Design + Engineered Precision
bodyHtml:
Manhattan Wall Faced Pan - 365 x 520 x 420 mm

The Versatile Series for Contemporary Spaces

The Manhattan toilet series brings together crisp lines and industry leading rimless flush performance to create the perfect fit for a wide variety of modern bathrooms.

Available in three configurations: Back to Wall Suite, Wall Faced Pan, and the Hi-Line version with AS 1428.1 Ambulant Compliance.


Manhattan Rimless Suite - 365 x 690 x 825 mm

Elevate with Matte White

In addition to the classic Gloss White, both the Manhattan Suite and Wall Faced Pan are offered in a timeless Matte White finish—an understated choice that brings a heightened sense of tactility and pairs effortlessly with a wide range of materials and surface palettes.


Manhattan Wall Faced Pan in Matte White - 365 x 520 x 420 mm

The Manhattan Hi-Line:
Design+Compliance

The Hi-Line offers an elevated seat and cistern height with an elongated pan, enhancing everyday comfort while meeting AS 1428.1 Ambulant Compliance requirements.

Ideal for both residential and commercial environments where accessibility is a priority, the Hi-Line balances functionality with aesthetic design.

Its proportions have been carefully considered to maintain a sleek, architectural silhouette—ensuring practical performance never comes at the expense of design intent.


AS 1428.1 Ambulant Compliant - Manhattan Hi Line

Hygiene, Built-In

All Studio Bagno toilets come standard with CleanMax — our advanced anti-bacterial glaze applied during the final firing process. This ultra-smooth barrier actively resists dirt build-up and inhibits bacterial growth on ceramic surfaces, making ongoing maintenance simpler and more effective.

Available at no additional cost across our entire toilet range, CleanMax is an integral part of our commitment to design that enhances everyday living.


Manhattan Wall Faced Pan with Slim Flush Button in Matte White
